block.title: Hello's library proofs share their compiled interfaces
block.p: Every library proof for GNU Hello used the same call contracts and the same exit-handler list. Each functor stored another copy of those definitions in its compiled interface. The bridge lemmas now refer directly to the contracts in HelloGlibcDebts and the resources in AtexitLogic.

With Rocq 9.3, the ten largest Hello library interfaces occupied 78.14 MiB before the change. The seven files that still supply those results occupy 108 KiB. Counting every glibc .vos in the dependency graph of the completed library record, including the record's own file, gives 94.48 MiB before and 15.27 MiB after.
